mathematics.assertion_tested: Conditional one-pump conversion efficiency and analytic optimization of ideal output decay
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Double precision Lyapunov solves, symbolic polynomial identity and bounded scalar optimization
mathematics.conventions: Two independent traveling optical modes; N=P L_eff/(c E_photon); pair population loss 2/tau; no phase noise or photon absorption
non_claims: Independent empty output mode is a granted assumption, not a solved mode of the earlier Fabry-Perot cavity
No universal impossibility bound on readout or identification of particles
Optimized efficiency assumes unlimited observation time and perfect detection
